verdict.rationale: Meilisearch stores your documents and embeddings and can be self-hosted as a single binary on your own machines, which gives operators indirect control over where data lives and how long it is kept. However, the pack documents no deletion API, retention policy, or purge mechanism, and the MCP integration lists only creating, adding, configuring and searching. Missing for 10: documented document/index deletion endpoints, configurable retention policies, deletion guarantees for embeddings and analytics data, any Cloud data-retention terms, and independent corroboration.
